title: Israeli forces arrest American human rights worker Mel Duncan in West Bank
detail: Israeli forces arrested American human rights worker Mel Duncan in the occupied West Bank, according to a news report published Nov 28, 2026. Based on a single headline-level report; charges, location and circumstances of the arrest were not available and are unverified.

title: Israeli army figures reveal sharp rise in settler attacks across West Bank
detail: A news report published Nov 28, 2026 says Israeli army figures show a sharp rise in Jewish settler attacks across the occupied West Bank. Based on a single headline-level report; the figures, time period and breakdown were not available and are unverified.
